ONGC to invest ₹20,000 crore annually in exploration until FY30

ONGC plans to invest ₹20,000 crore annually in exploration activities until FY30, totaling approximately ₹1 trillion. The company will drill over 350 wells, including both onshore and offshore locations. The exploration will commence with drilling 8 deepwater wells by March 2027, followed by an additional 10 wells by March 2028. This investment aims to boost oil and gas production.
